diagnosis: The telehealth portal handler initiates an HTTP/2 server push of clinical patient history and oncology diagnosis based on query parameter patientId without verifying provider-patient assignment or patient identity. Any connected HTTP/2 client can request patient-overview with another patientId and receive pushed medical records.
exploit_request:
GET /portal/patient-overview?patientId=pat_oncology_55102 HTTP/2
Host: healthportal.internal:8444
Accept: text/html
